text: If they produce in one section of the country what is called for by the wants of another section, and this other section can supply the wants of the first, they are not matters of discord, but bonds of union, true bonds of union.
author: Abraham Lincoln
reference: Speeches and Letters of Abraham Lincoln, 1832-1865
locator: From Lincoln's Reply to Douglas in the First Joint Debate at Ottawa, Illinois. August 21, 1858
